question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **marked**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Marked **refers to something that is noticeable, significant and clearly evident. (कुछ ऐसा जो ध्यान देने योग्य, महत्वपूर्ण और स्पष्ट रूप से स्पष्ट हो)
 
• In this context, "**marked**" is used to indicate that personal contacts have a noticeable or significant influence on our judgments.
 
• It implies that the impact is distinctive or clear.
 
• So, "**marked**" is the appropriate choice as it serves as an adjective, conveying the idea that personal contacts have a noticeable or significant influence on our judgments of countries and peoples.

Thus, **option 1** is the correct answer.
